messages:
maria: Heads-up — proposing a new synthetic probe suite for streaming embeddings + streaming chat that correlates probe signals with GPU indicators (nvml), pod restarts, and node-level network metrics. Goal: detect degradation earlier than customer 99p latency spikes.

alex: Love it. Which signals are must-haves? CPU/GPU/mem, queue depth, socket errors?

maria: Core set: nvidia_gpu_util, nvidia_gpu_mem_used, inference_queue_length, kv_cache_hit_rate, net_rtt_ms, ws_handshake_fail_count, probe_success, probe_latency_ms_bucket, probe_stream_fragment_errors.

sam: We should source probes from three colocations per region (edge -> egress, control-plane subnet, GCE egress) to catch routing anomalies.

jia: Cost question: what sampling rate? Running cross-region streaming checks can add up.

maria: Start conservative: interval 30s, but low sample_rate per model/colo. Rough: ~10k checks/day across three regions and two probe types. We'll tune after initial signals.

alex: For streaming probes we must prime KV cache (warmup) before measurement, otherwise probes always measure cold-path and are noisy.

sam: Agreed. Warmup flow: open ws -> send priming token -> close -> wait jitter -> open test stream. Keep jitter random in 0-3s.

maria: Draft blackbox-like YAML for the harness (for PR):
```yaml
probe_name: synth_streaming_checks
regions: [us-central1, eu-west1, ap-southeast1]
colos: [edge, control]
interval: 30s
sample_rate: 0.01
types:
  - streaming_chat:
      model: rdx-3b-v1
      warmup: true
      warmup_prompt: "prime_kv_for_probe"
      test_duration_s: 8
  - embeddings:
      model: rdx-embed-xxl
      batch_size: 3
      validate_similarity: true
headers:
  Authorization: "Bearer $SYNTH_KEY"
expectations:
  - status: 200
  - no_stream_fragment_errors: true
metrics:
  - synth_probe_success
  - synth_probe_latency_ms_bucket
  - synth_stream_fragment_errors
  - synth_kv_warmup_ms
```

jia: Use short-lived synth keys rotated daily and scoped tokens with strict rate caps. Ops: cost estimate in PR pls.

alex: On Prom side: export synth_* metrics and create recording rules like synth:probe_latency_p95 by region. Example queries to correlate with GPU: 
``
# P95 probe latency per region
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(synth_probe_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))

# 5m avg GPU util > 80%
avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_utilization_percent{job="node-exporter"}[5m]) > 80
```

sam: Avoid paging for short bursts. Recommend composite alert that requires both high probe latency and sustained GPU pressure.

maria: Example composite alert idea: HighProbeLatencyWithGPUPressure => p95_probe_latency > 500ms AND avg_gpu_util[5m] > 80% for 5m -> page. Lower severity for probe failures alone.

ops-bot: Grafana template created: "Synthetics / Streaming + Embeds" panels: p95 latency, success rate, fragment error rate, kv warmup latency, GPU util overlay. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/synth-streaming (internal link)

jia: Note: ap-southeast1 has a smaller GPU pool. If synthetic traffic pushes latency, throttle synth sample_rate or move probes to control-plane colo to avoid stealing customer capacity.

alex: Implement a per-region synth quota. Gate ap-southeast1 at 0.2% until capacity increases.

sam: SNAT port exhaustion risk with many short-lived ws streams. Probe harness should do connection pooling, keepalive, and limit concurrent streams per IP.

maria: Runbook outline: 
- If synth p95 > SLO and GPU util > 80%: route traffic to fallback model/region, notify oncall.
- If synth failure rate spikes but GPU util low: check ws handshake errors, NAT metrics, and node network drop counters.
- If embed similarity drifts: trigger eval-run on stored promptset and rollback if regression confirmed.

alex: Action items:
- maria: add probe config + YAML to synth repo (PR)
- sam: add KV warmup + jitter into harness
- jia: create scoped synth keys and post cost estimate
- ops-bot: open dashboard + alert rules PR

maria: I'll open PRs today and tag reviewers. Adding X-Synth-Trace header to correlate probe -> pod logs -> NVML metrics is a must.

lee: +1 on trace header. That will help correlate request -> container logs -> GPU metrics quickly.

sam: I'll run a 48h canary after merge and post results in #eng-sre.

ops-bot: Runbook templates: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/synthetic-probes

maria: Closing loop: will include initial cost estimate and sample signal distributions in the PR description. Thanks all :thumbsup:
